title: System Cards for AI-Based Automated Decision Systems
benchmark_measurement: The paper proposes a general framework for auditing AI-based automated decision systems. It includes criteria for 'nondiscrimination' and 'fairness' concerning protected attributes, but does not explicitly mention or measure any aspect of faith or religion.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it is not a subject of its analysis. The focus is on a general accountability framework for AI systems.
